prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: During the project kickoff for Northwind Logistics, it was decided that a three-phase rollout will occur, starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in the first two weeks of May, and a decision gate before wider deployment. The integration requirement mandates running any connectors within the client's on-premise network, and the finance committee will review a budget of up to $50,000 after evaluating the pilot results in June. Action items include revising the pilot schedule, documenting the integration approach, and confirming coordinator allocation.
output_text: During the Northwind Logistics project kickoff, it was decided to implement a three-phase rollout beginning with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, and a decision gate before wider deployment.
